ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels in the medial regions to low-intensity black pixels along the peripheral margins and central notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric regions occupy the central portions of both lobes. The right lobe contains a single prominent dark vertical linear feature. The margins, notch area, and tips are defined by low-intensity black pixels with irregular, mottled transitions into the white central fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior pixel angle of 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) are present across the entire visible trailing edge, with increased amplitude and density at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a concave upward and outward curve from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured clusters of light and dark pixels consistent with barnacle colonization are clearly visible at the far left and far right distal tips of the fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct dark vertical linear disruption (scratch) is located on the right lobe, approximately 75% of the distance from the notch to the right tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical linear scar on the right lobe; dense barnacle clusters present on both lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Minor dark pixel mottling is observed within the white field of the right lobe near the junction with the median notch.
